THIRD-PARTY NOTICES — TestOrchestrator

TestOrchestrator bundles the third-party components listed below. Licence
texts are shipped alongside this file in 3rdparty/licenses/ and are readable
in the application under "Third-party notices" (works fully offline).

Python runtime components (see requirements.txt for pinned versions):
  Flask, Flask-Login, Flask-SQLAlchemy, Flask-Migrate, Flask-WTF, Werkzeug,
  Jinja2, itsdangerous, click, blinker, WTForms, MarkupSafe — BSD-3-Clause
  SQLAlchemy — MIT
  alembic, Mako — MIT
  argon2-cffi, argon2-cffi-bindings, cffi, pycparser — MIT
  typing_extensions — PSF
  waitress — ZPL-2.1-derived (see waitress-*-LICENSE.txt)

Reverse proxy / TLS terminator (binary, see 3rdparty/caddy/):
  Caddy — Apache License 2.0
